title: A new chess variant
author: Neragocoil
selftext:
Hello there! After 20 years in the SW industry, having videogames as my passion, I decided to go ahead and create my own videogame, starting small.

Im good at code, but I used to suck at art, I can draw, but assets and so on, nah, always put me down when facing a project (this must be my fourth attempt).

So basically, after experimenting with AI I managed to be able to work in the code and have a proper approach to the assets generation, I basically do a template with pixellab, modify with aseprite and have a custom pipeline for animations (now with Astra things have scaled I think...).

Anyway here is my project, a chess game with a twist, not every capture is guaranteed, I have fantasy characters that level up and four campaigns and 9 races so far. I'm happy with the result, I like to play it a lot, and have received positive feedback for testers that were not family or friends 😂

Demo coming soon, meanwhile, behold!! My stuff!

Chaos Chess!
